repositories.decision_reason: Source and tests show a reusable mechanism for representing long-running agent workflows as typed graph state plus checkpoint metadata, parent checkpoint links, pending writes, durability modes, task streams, and interrupt/error recovery.
repositories.revisit_reason: Review production checkpointer behavior and any post-0.6 changes to durable interrupt semantics.
repositories.next_revisit_condition: Revisit after a material change to checkpoint storage, interrupt handling, or managed runtime semantics.

repositories.decision_reason: The reviewed spec and client code provide a stable, versioned envelope for run/job/dataset events, producer identity, schema identity, parent runs, column lineage, and pluggable transports.
repositories.revisit_reason: Compare with DataHub/OpenMetadata ingestion models before standardizing an internal provenance envelope.
repositories.next_revisit_condition: Revisit when adopting lineage events for non-data workflows or when OpenLineage changes major schema versions.

repositories.decision_reason: Graphiti has source evidence for episode-anchored entity/fact extraction, edge deduplication, temporal invalidation, and hybrid retrieval, but important extraction and contradiction decisions are LLM-mediated and need stronger confidence/evidence modeling before adoption.
repositories.revisit_reason: Track whether Graphiti adds explicit confidence, evidence hashes, or deterministic validation around extracted facts.
repositories.next_revisit_condition: Revisit after releases that add confidence scoring, provenance export, or deterministic validation of LLM-extracted facts.
